Panaji, 1st March, 2013 (Phalguna 10, 1934) SERIES II No. 48

EXTRAORDINARY

GOVERNMENT OF GOA

Department of Urban Development
Directorate of Municipal Administration
___

Order

No. 10/306/2012/Elect/Sanquelim/Part-III/2977

I, Sandip Jacques, Director of Municipal Administration/Urban Development in exercise of the
powers vested in me under sub-section (1) of Section 10 of the Goa Municipalities Act, 1968, hereby fix
the number of Wards of Sanquelim Municipal Council shown in Column 2 into which the Municipal area
is divided to the extent shown in Column 4 of the Schedule appended hereto, corresponding to the
Municipal Council shown in Column 1 of the said Schedule.

The seats reserved for women of the said Municipal Council shall be the ward numbers 2, 5, 8
and 11.
